title: Create an AWS CDK app
description: Scaffold an AWS CDK app that synthesizes one CDK Stage per environment, with a Lambda construct that has production-ready defaults and an example stack.

directory.description: The directory the CDK app is created in, e.g. `apps/infra`.
directory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create the CDK app in?

name.description: The Nx project name. Defaults to the last segment of `directory`.

stages.description: The environments to deploy to. Each becomes a CDK Stage whose stacks are named `<stage>-<Stack>`. A stage named `production` or `prod` retains data and logs on delete.

region.description: The AWS region every stage deploys to. Change individual stages afterwards in `src/config.ts`.

exampleStack.description: The name of an example stack to generate, with one Lambda function. Pass an empty string to skip it.
